heading: The toolkit in five layers
intro: Electrical fundamentals at the bottom, applied AI at the top. Every layer here is something I have shipped with, not just read about.

bands.name: Circuits
bands.use: Electronic fundamentals and circuit analysis, simulated in Multisim NI and Proteus before anything touches a board.

bands.name: Go
bands.use: RESTful APIs with Gin and GORM, clean architecture, Swagger-documented endpoints, JWT access control.

bands.name: SvelteKit
bands.use: TypeScript front ends for practicum platforms serving 20–40 students per cycle.

bands.name: RAG + BERT
bands.use: Retrieval-augmented grading that evaluates 100+ student answers a session, 60–70% less manual work.

bands.name: PostgreSQL
bands.use: Schemas designed up front for exam engines, lab records, and scoring that has to stay consistent.
